title: Activate Offer, Deposit $1000 Per Month (Nov, Dec. Jan) into Orange Everyday Account, Get Bonus $20 Per Month @ ING
body:
Deal: Activate Offer, Deposit $1000 Per Month (Nov, Dec. Jan) into Orange Everyday Account, Get Bonus $20 Per Month @ ING

[tenpercent] Targeted via email? SMS? Message on the app / website? Carrier pigeon?
[drfuzzy] Email here. Note: I haven't topped up the account in several months. I suspect regular users might not be targetted
[kryptexAndroid] snail actually delivered it to me in my mailbox.
[nige0090] Can you later withdraw the $1000?
The email does not say
[Nayf3r105] I think the account has to keep growing because I did this the last time they had the same offer (around a year ago) and didn't get any bonuses for months. Closed the account after.
[gadgetguy] The T&C make no mention of maintaining $1000 in the account as a requirement.
Ongoing Criteria
To meet the Ongoing Criteria, you must:
• Have already satisfied the Activation Criteria; and
• Make deposits totalling at least $1,000 into any Orange Everyday account in your name from an external source in each consecutive calendar month of the Promotion Period; and
• Hold an active and unrestricted Orange Everyday account at the time the $20 bonus is paid.
If you meet the Ongoing Criteria in each consecutive month of the Promotion Period, ING will make a single payment of $20 to you in the calendar month after the Ongoing Criteria is met (although in some cases this may take longer).
[modernconsumer] Same here, but also need to maintain $100 in savings account or have a home loan.
[glazinbrah] Never received my $20 from my last deposit of $1000, contacted ING and they werent helpful at all.
